style: Felt applique and schematic word-part diagrams
provider: Built-in image generation and deterministic SVG diagrams
note: Pictures support the lesson text and do not replace decoding or evidence from narration. Key lesson word-part examples have native editable labels; other schematic marks illustrate organization. Read sort statements in their supplied context. Educator review is pending.

sources.prompt: Square text-free educational illustration in tactile felt applique and stitched fabric style. A friendly orange cat sits on a teal woven mat beside a separate broad-brimmed purple hat. All three objects clear and fully visible, ivory background. No people, no letters, no numbers. Teach cat, hat, mat through recognizable objects. Simple fabric shapes, not photorealistic.
sources.alt: An orange felt cat sits on a teal mat beside a separate purple hat.
sources.caption: Cat, hat and mat share the written ending at and rhyme in the pronunciation used here. Read the words in the app and blend their sounds; do not guess a word from the picture alone.

sources.prompt: Square text-free educational illustration in tactile felt applique and stitched fabric style. A pink pig uses its snout to dig a small patch of loose brown soil. A distinct forked twig rests beside the hole. Large simple clear objects on ivory backdrop. No people, lettering, numbers or watermark. Show pig, dig, twig without labels; no tools held by pig.
sources.alt: A pink felt pig pushes its snout into loose soil beside a forked twig.
sources.caption: Pig, dig and twig share the ending ig. The scene cues meanings; decoding the written words supplies their sounds.
